title: Animation metadata
description: Contains animated texture metadata for a PNG texture file.

interpolate.description: If true, the game will generate frames with display time greater than 1 between frames. Defaults to false.

frametime.description: Sets the time increment for each frame per game tick. Defaults to 1.

frames.description: A list of frames. The display order defaults from top to bottom.

oneOf.description: The position of the frame to start playing. The topmost frame is 0.

index.description: The position of the frame to start playing. The topmost frame is 0.

time.description: Display time for this frame (in ticks), overriding the global frametime above.

width.description: The width of the frame, measured in direct proportion rather than pixels. Unused in vanilla but can be used by mods for non-square frames.

height.description: The height of the frame, measured in direct proportion rather than pixels. Unused in vanilla but can be used by mods for non-square frames.
